meta.title: 被辞退后面试怎么解释？背调攻略
meta.title_en: How to Explain a Termination: A Background-Check Playbook

scenes.title_en: When Your Boss Supports the Check
scenes.context: 讲者给出第一种情形：前主管愿意配合背调，就可以避开被辞退的话题。
sentences: 如果因为个人业绩不佳被辞退，下家面试怎么解释呢？
If you were let go for poor performance, how do you explain it in the next interview?
业绩不佳：poor performance
请上家公司主管支持你，配合你的入职背调。
Ask your former boss to support you in the background check.
入职背调：background check
选择一个恰当的主动离职原因作说辞，比如个人发展或家庭因素。
Use a proper voluntary-reason like personal growth or family matters.
主动离职原因：voluntary reason
paraphrase: 背调支持 → 绕开辞退话题
With the boss's support, you can skip the termination topic.
换一个体面的主动离职理由
Swap it for a decent, voluntary reason to leave.
scenes.speak: If you were let go for poor performance, how do you explain it in the next interview? Ask your former boss to support you in the background check. Use a proper voluntary-reason like personal growth or family matters.

scenes.context: 讲者给出第二种情形：前主管不支持背调，只能实话实说但弱化原因、聚焦成长。
sentences: 如果前主管不支持你的背调，我们只能实话实说。
If your former boss won't back you, you have to tell the truth.
实话实说：tell the truth
弱化被辞退的原因，把重点放在你得到的教训上。
Downplay the termination and focus on the lesson you learned.
弱化原因：downplay the reason
讲清楚做了哪些弥补措施，比如培训、充电。
Talk about the steps you took to make up, like training and upskilling.
弥补措施：steps to make up
paraphrase: 实话实说 ≠ 全盘交代
Being honest doesn't mean disclosing everything.
把焦点从「被辞」转到「成长」
Shift the focus from being fired to how you grew.
scenes.speak: If your former boss won't back you, you have to tell the truth. Downplay the termination and focus on the lesson you learned. Talk about the steps you took to make up, like training and upskilling.

scenes.context: 讲者强调无论多委屈，面试时都绝不说原公司负面信息。
sentences: 一定要记住一个原则：不讲原公司的负面信息。
Always remember one rule: never trash your old company.
负面信息：trash / bad-mouth
不管你认为自己被辞退有多么不公。
No matter how unfair you think the termination was.
有多么不公：how unfair it was
不要讲原公司、原主管、原同事的负面信息。
Don't bad-mouth your former company, boss, or coworkers.
讲负面：bad-mouth
paraphrase: 委屈也不讲负面 → 守住格局
No matter how unfair it feels, keep your composure and stay positive.
把负面删掉 → 换成成长叙事
Cut the negativity and replace it with a growth story.
scenes.speak: Always remember one rule: never trash your old company. No matter how unfair you think the termination was. Don't bad-mouth your former company, boss, or coworkers.

practice: I was let go from my last role.
My former manager was willing to support my background check.
Looking back, I learned a valuable lesson from that experience.
I took courses to upskill and improve my performance.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：I was fired by the company.
✓ 地道说法：I was let go from my last role.
被辞退用 let go，更中性、不刺耳。
✕ 直译腔：The manager supports my background check.
✓ 地道说法：My former manager agreed to back me in the background check.
配合背调用 back / support，比 supports my check 完整。
✕ 直译腔：Don't say negative information of old company.
✓ 地道说法：Never bad-mouth your former company.
讲负面信息用 bad-mouth / trash，更口语。
✕ 直译腔：I made up the reason.
✓ 地道说法：I gave a proper voluntary reason.
说辞不是造假，是 give a proper reason。
shifts: 被辞退就心虚、回避话题
按背调支持度选择解释策略
被问到就全盘交代细节
弱化原因，聚焦教训与弥补
委屈时忍不住吐槽原公司
守住红线，绝不说负面信息
footer_notes: ASR 校正：原文「备调」按语境校正为「背调」，「退书」校正为「背书」，「档位」校正为「岗位」，「个人技巧不大」校正为「个人业绩不佳」。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
